bio: Breathe in an aroma, a perfume, a bouquet… such is the enticing agenda that awaits diners at this elegant establishment off the Champs-Élysées. A devotee of seasonal produce, chef Thomas Boullault meticulously prepares a polished contemporary line-up. The set menus reflect the seasons and what’s going at the market. You will fall under the spell of his delicate, balanced handiwork: lobster ravioles with Mexican tarragon or loin of venison rubbed with Manakara berries… Scents and flavours to savour and appreciate in a tastefully stylish setting....
